article.title: Participio activo presente
article.part: Participios y deeprichastiya — Причастия и деепричастия

claims.summary: The present active participle in Russian describes a person or thing that is performing an action or doing so habitually. It behaves like an adjective, accompanying a noun and agreeing with it in gender, number, and case.

The present active participle is called 'active' because the modified noun is the participant that performs the action. It is 'present' because it expresses an action happening simultaneously with the moment or situation being described. It is formed from imperfective verbs, which present the action as a process or habitual activity.

The article provides examples of the present active participle in use, showing how it agrees with the noun in gender, number, and case, and how it is used in sentences to describe actions being performed.
